The calculation of the box's corners now uses `k*dy` and `k*dx`. Furthermore, the slope of the examples (positive or negative) seems to be critical, although there may be more factors involved. I've noted that `k` is probably related to the placement of each corner. Finally, I've confirmed a grid size and some basic computations to verify this idea on a 27x27 grid.
